method.external_artifacts: none; no weights, no activation caches, no dataset payload
method.record_content: record files carry immutable sample ids, four-mode log-probability scores, predictions, Router probabilities, arm identity, dose and destination -- no prompt, no answer-candidate string, no dialogue and no generated text
method.sealed_ids: SEALED sample identifiers appear here by design: this IS the formal SEALED result. They are opaque uuids, not payload.
method.self_exclusion: the scanner's own source and output are excluded
